description: This file defines a custom Android UI component `TvChannelCard`, a complex view representing a TV channel card with various UI elements such as thumbnails, badges, progress bar, and text labels. It is used to display program info, live status, and rental badge for a TV channel within the app's layout.

classes.name: TvChannelCard
classes.description: A custom view class for displaying TV channel information as a card with program details, live indicator, rental badge, and program progress bar, optimized for Android TV navigation.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a `TvChannel` object to the view, updating all UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds TV channel data to the card view.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts dp units to pixel units for layout sizing.
